changelog:
- Initial release of the adsb-overhead skill.
- Detects nearby aircraft using a local readsb SBS/BaseStation TCP feed.
- Configurable home coordinates, radius, alert cooldown, and listen time.
- Designed for periodic (cron) checks and WhatsApp notifications via Clawdbot.
- Persists alert state to a local JSON file to avoid duplicate notifications.
summary: Notify when aircraft are overhead within a configurable radius using a local ADS-B SBS/BaseStation feed (readsb port 30003). Use when setting up or troubleshooting plane-overhead alerts, configuring radius/home coordinates/cooldowns, or creating a Clawdbot cron watcher that sends WhatsApp notifications for nearby aircraft.
